summary: Signal attention changes outside a client's visible window so complete-cohort consumers can refresh their global review backlog

replay.detail: No authoritative claims or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: Whole-cohort fingerprints are volatile publication/window metadata; no database or generated client schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, admission and person authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The existing changes frame may have empty upserts/removes and unchanged visible order, has_more and store_index when hidden compatible attention content changes. Complete-cohort consumers must treat every accepted attention data frame as invalidation. Existing bounded clients can apply these frames unchanged; no wire fields or protocol version are added. Known Snooze expiry remains a local eligibility recomputation; time never promotes priority to Critical.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon update/restart only; no schema migration or fleet downtime requirement.

manual.detail: No new configuration or manual migration steps. Existing future-eligibility scheduling and clock cadence are retained.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores prefix-only invalidation. All claims remain intact and volatile views rebuild normally.
